chromTFR: Quantification of Chromatin Accessibility Signatures in TFBS

Source: R/chromTFR-package.R
chromTFR-package.Rd

chromTFR quantifies transcription factor footprints in chromatin accessibility data using the annotation of the methylTFR package. Tn5 insertion densities replace methylation levels, and the expected profile of a motif is derived either from the GC bin composition of its binding sites or from a k-mer model of the Tn5 sequence preference. The package computes bias corrected deviation scores per sample and motif, draws the underlying footprints and summarises the deviations as a heatmap.
